# CANDIDATE: BEARISH_REJECTION_VOLUME_CONFIRMATION

**Filed:** 2026-07-22  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** filter_change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Adding a volume confirmation condition to the BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON setup will improve entry quality by avoiding breakdowns lacking follow-through volume, thereby increasing win rate on J winner days and reducing losses on J loser days. The playbook already notes volume divergence as a failure condition; this formalizes it as a strict entry filter.

## Mechanism

In addition to existing BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON context filters and trigger conditions, require:  
1. Breakdown bar volume ≥ 1.5× 20-bar average volume  
2. Next bar's volume < breakdown bar's volume (to avoid immediate high-volume recovery)  
Exit logic unchanged: chart stop (primary), chandelier profit-lock, premium stop (catastrophe cap), time stop.
